scenario_summary: Customer is disputing an unrecognized $76 charge on his account and requesting a refund if unauthorized.

conversation.message: Hi, my name is Javier Gonzalez and I'm 45. I noticed a $76 charge on my account from two days ago that I don't recognize. I haven't made any recent purchases that I can think of, though it's possible I forgot about something small. Can you look into it, and if it turns out I really didn't authorize it, can you refund it?
Hello Javier. I can certainly help you look into that charge. To start, could you please provide your account number and the zip code associated with your billing address?
Sure, my account number is 8849201 and the zip is 90210.
Thank you. Just to be safe, could you also confirm the last four digits of the phone number we have on file for you?

Thanks. I see the $76 transaction here from 'Global Tech Services'. It doesn't look like a standard merchant we see often. Per our standard terms, I need to verify if you have any recurring subscriptions that might match this amount?
No, I don't have any subscriptions for that amount. I'm pretty careful about those.

I see. I'm looking at the transaction details, and it's flagged as an online point-of-sale purchase. Since I can't definitively identify the merchant as a known partner, I'm going to go ahead and open a formal dispute for this charge to protect your account.
Okay, that sounds right. What happens next?
I've officially submitted the dispute case, number 99283-J. You'll receive an email shortly with the details. We'll investigate and get back to you within 5-7 business days.

escalation_reason: The agent could not identify the merchant and initiated a formal dispute process, which requires back-office investigation.

judge_scores.justification: The agent efficiently verified the customer's identity and account details with an appropriate level of rigor for a financial dispute. While the policy reference regarding standard terms was somewhat vague, the agent took proper action by opening a formal dispute for an unrecognized merchant transaction.
